explanation: Implement only clear_deliver from the acknowledged closed-grasp state at frame 240. Do not replay the grasp or the completed retention lift. Two acquisition reviews at most replace the failed narrow-landmark angular estimate with a current, wide planar face patch and tabletop measurements. A finite asin orientation allowance and validated historical full-package extent bounds produce a new whole-package separation test; the old 0.940-rad small-angle result is not treated as an obstruction or a runtime constraint. An observed short end and those bounds define an enclosing footprint, not reconstructed hidden corners. Current inner-rim depth and identified boundary rays support bowl geometry. Reviews separately admit departure, lateral travel and future placement actions. An inconclusive opening margin can permit a separately admitted, observation-producing departure, but not lateral delivery; one changed-view rim estimate may then resolve it without lowering its threshold. Execute only a departure and two elevated lateral legs, maintaining the existing gripper command and orientation. Independent labeled surface measurements must follow actual hand motion after each leg. Final success requires fresh rim validation, retained co-motion, measured above-bowl alignment and supported placement, release and withdrawal conditions. The method never places or releases the package. Normally five reviews are used, with seven as an absolute local ceiling and the specified model reserve preserved. Source length reflects bounded acquisition, gate diagnostics and recovery within this stage, not later-stage control.
interface: Python main(api), using only supplied api, np, math and geo. Return a JSON-compatible object with stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff and completion_proposed=false. Read retain_gate for historical dimension-bound provenance and pick_reference for visual/metric validation; do not treat their old thresholds as external constraints. Persist compact consumed observations in deliver_measure, geometry and admission in deliver_ref, whole-lease state progress in deliver_progress, differential and final effect evidence in deliver_effect, exact failed gates in deliver_gate, and the returned outcome in deliver_result. Existing historical checkpoints are retained. The handoff enumerates only existing deliver_* records and supplies current state, separation and placement-ready evidence. World units are meters, tool quaternions xyzw; named graphic landmarks retain physical identities across camera movement. Each checkpoint value is limited to compact points and summaries, with no dense clouds or full review responses. Follow-on methods must revalidate affected references, especially after descent or contact.
jev_protocol: The seven Jev questions are x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,gripper. Each axis question explicitly binds its own state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation: negative means decreasing that world translation or world rotation-vector component, positive increasing it, and hold its declared deadband. The gripper question binds state.processed_features.objective.gripper; keep preserves the acknowledged closed grasp. Open and close are defined but never requested by this stage. Jev receives trusted current proprioception and pose residuals plus source-labeled scalar separation, enclosing radius, opening margin, tolerance, phase and call-use features. Jev chooses directions; it neither computes geometric metrics nor supplies unseen-object observations. api.drive invokes real Jev for every physical update and dispatches answers unchanged. Fixed orientation and keep are used throughout, with translation limit 0.015 m, rotation limit 0.04 rad and three native steps per decision. Position tolerance is selected from the measured opening margin within 0.0005-0.002 m; angular tolerance is 0.01 rad. Each lease uses at most 30 calls, at most three leases per leg, at most 60 stage calls, and preserves at least 48 calls and 144 steps for subsequent work. Host slice boundaries do not cause yield. Lease exhaustion is not failure if the complete lease made measured pose progress, an independent landmark/actual-hand comparison confirms continued retention, and fresh scoped admission still supports the remaining motion. Stalls, ineffective corrections, slip or failed geometry stop rather than replay. Real GPT reviews supply identities and action-specific visual interpretations; api.point, plane_point, calibration and geo helpers supply metric geometry. Tracker availability is irrelevant because independently identifiable graphic landmarks replace tracking. Attachment error is compared with measured hand displacement and sensor/model uncertainty, explicitly excluding a stationary-object explanation. Patch spread is used only relative to residual/noise for observable plane orientation, never as an absolute object-size gate. Numerical allowances are declared operational heuristics, physical dimensions are validated historical measured/model bounds, and API resource limits remain external constraints. All numerical failures preserve operands, thresholds, uncertainty and observation frames before returning. Only fresh stage-effect evidence permits stage_complete; completion_proposed always remains false.
